identify_anomalies: As a breast imaging specialist, carefully analyze this mammogram. Identify any abnormal findings, masses, calcifications, architectural distortions, or other suspicious features. Describe the location, characteristics, margins, and density using BI-RADS terminology. Assess the clinical significance of any abnormalities you observe. If no clear abnormalities are visible, state that the mammogram appears normal.
describe_slice: As a breast imaging specialist, provide a detailed description of this mammogram. Identify the breast composition (ACR density category), visible anatomical structures (pectoral muscle, nipple, subcutaneous tissue), and describe the overall tissue distribution and image quality. Mention any notable anatomical landmarks or tissue patterns that are clearly visible.
suggest_labels: This is a mammogram image. Please list the anatomical structures and any pathological findings that are visible. Return a comma-separated list of possible labels using BI-RADS terminology (e.g., dense tissue, mass, calcifications, nipple, pectoral muscle, fatty tissue, etc.).

mg_label_suggestions.title: Mammography Label Suggestion Prompt
mg_label_suggestions.description: Specialized prompt for generating anatomical and pathological labels in mammography images
mg_label_suggestions.prompt:
You are an expert breast radiologist examining a mammography image. Please analyze this mammogram and suggest appropriate labels for the visible structures and findings. For each structure or finding you identify, provide:

1. Structure/Finding name (e.g., 'Dense Tissue', 'Fatty Tissue', 'Mass', 'Calcifications', 'Nipple', 'Pectoral Muscle')
2. Location (e.g., 'Upper Outer Quadrant', 'Central', 'Subareolar')
3. Characteristics (e.g., 'Round', 'Irregular', 'Spiculated', 'Clustered')
4. Clinical significance if relevant

Focus on clearly visible anatomical structures and any abnormal findings. Use BI-RADS terminology where appropriate.

Format your response as a structured list with clear labels and descriptions.

breast_region_analysis.title: Breast Region Analysis
breast_region_analysis.description: Detailed analysis of breast tissue and structures in mammography
breast_region_analysis.prompt:
As a breast imaging specialist, examine this mammogram and provide a detailed analysis. Include:

- Breast tissue composition (fatty, scattered fibroglandular, heterogeneously dense, extremely dense)
- Anatomical structures visible (pectoral muscle, nipple, skin line)
- Tissue distribution patterns
- Symmetry assessment (if comparing with other views)
- Any notable features or variants

Provide precise breast imaging terminology and clinical context where appropriate.

pathology_detection.title: Mammography Pathology Detection
pathology_detection.description: Identify and describe potential pathological findings in mammography
pathology_detection.prompt:
Examine this mammogram as an experienced breast radiologist looking for pathological findings. Report:

1. Normal breast tissue patterns present
2. Any masses (describe shape, margins, density)
3. Calcifications (describe morphology and distribution)
4. Architectural distortions
5. Asymmetries
6. Skin or nipple changes
7. Overall BI-RADS assessment if appropriate

Use appropriate BI-RADS terminology and indicate confidence levels for any findings. If no pathology is evident, state this clearly.

educational_description.title: Educational Mammography Description
educational_description.description: Comprehensive educational description suitable for medical students and residents
educational_description.prompt:
Describe this mammogram in detail for medical education purposes. Include:

**Imaging Parameters:**
- View type (CC, MLO, lateral, etc.)
- Image quality assessment
- Breast positioning quality

**Breast Composition:**
- Tissue density (BI-RADS categories)
- Glandular tissue distribution
- Fatty tissue patterns

**Anatomical Landmarks:**
- Pectoral muscle (if visible)
- Nipple location
- Inframammary fold

**Educational Points:**
- Key learning objectives
- Important anatomical relationships
- Clinical correlations
- BI-RADS terminology

Make this accessible to learners while maintaining accuracy.

technical_analysis.title: Technical Mammography Quality Analysis
technical_analysis.description: Technical assessment of mammography image quality
technical_analysis.prompt:
Provide a technical quality analysis of this mammogram focusing on:

**Image Quality:**
- Positioning adequacy
- Compression adequacy
- Exposure parameters appropriateness
- Artifacts present (if any)
- Contrast and sharpness

**Technical Assessment:**
- Inclusion of all breast tissue
- Pectoral muscle visualization (for MLO views)
- Skin line visibility
- Image labeling correctness

**Recommendations:**
- Suitability for diagnostic interpretation
- Need for additional views
- Technical improvements needed (if any)

Focus on technical imaging aspects rather than clinical findings.
